title: BLaDA: Bridging Language to Functional Dexterous Actions within 3DGS Fields
authors: Fan Yang, Wenrui Chen, Guorun Yan, Ruize Liao, Wanjun Jia, Dongsheng Luo, Jiacheng Lin, Kailun Yang, Zhiyong Li, Yaonan Wang

tldr.zh: BLaDA 用语言 Agent 将指令解析为部位、手指角色、抓型和力度等约束，在语义 3DGS 中定位并构建三点接触结构，再通过几何变换与抓握模板生成手腕位姿、手指关节和施力指令。
tldr.en: BLaDA uses a language Agent to parse instructions into region, finger-role, grasp-type and force constraints, localizes a three-point contact structure in semantic 3DGS, then maps geometry and grasp templates to wrist poses, finger joints and force commands.

evaluation_scope.zh: KLP 结合 F2F 知识及上下文示例输出六元组：抓取区域、手指角色、抓型、力度、工具拓扑和任务意图。TriLocation 用多视角重建的物体／部件语义高斯场定位功能点，并以任务—拓扑局部坐标系对齐三点手模板；KGT3D+ 由三点计算腕部位姿，F2F 库将抓型和力度映射为关节配置及期望手指力分布。底层采用几何变换和预定义抓握库，未训练 RL 动作策略；未展示高层反馈重规划。零样本指无需任务专用动作策略训练，场景重建、特征蒸馏及定位模块仍涉及优化／训练。真机为 Franka＋6 自由度 Inspire Hand、RealSense D435i；覆盖四类意图 Hold／Press／Open／Click。图 8 注明除手指施力外，抓后运动由示教完成；期望力度不是触觉闭环，论文将触觉反馈列为后续工作。官方已公开代码及安装、训练和静态场景使用说明；数据与预训练权重下载尚未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: KLP combines F2F knowledge and examples into six fields: region, finger role, grasp type, force, tool topology and intent. TriLocation locates a functional anchor in multiview object/part semantic Gaussians and aligns a three-point hand template using task/topology frames. KGT3D+ computes wrist pose; F2F supplies joint configurations and desired finger forces. Execution uses geometry/templates without RL action-policy training or demonstrated high-level replanning. Zero-shot excludes task-specific policy training, not scene/feature optimization or localization learning. Hardware uses Franka, a 6-DoF Inspire Hand and D435i, covering Hold/Press/Open/Click. Figure 8 identifies post-grasp motions other than finger-force actuation as demonstrated; force commands do not establish tactile feedback. Official code and installation/training/static-scene instructions are public; dataset and pretrained-weight downloads remain unverified.
